verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI documents a Pull Request Reviews feature with 'automated code review with contextual feedback and suggestions' (gh-10) plus issue/PR automation via GitHub Action integration (gh-4, gh-22), and a community report independently confirms it catches bugs reviewers missed in code review comparisons (comm-20). However, this is mostly delivered via the GitHub Action integration rather than a native diff-inspection UI in the CLI itself, and there's no explicit evidence of running test/lint checks as part of a merge workflow. Missing for 10: dedicated diff-viewing UX in the terminal, integrated test/CI check running before merge, and broader independent corroboration beyond one HN comment.
